title: The Story Behind Lesaka | Lincoln Mali on Metro FM
body_markdown:
#### You may already know EasyPay, EasyPay Everywhere, Kazang, GAAP or Adumo. But how do they all fit into the Lesaka story?


###


Our CEO, Lincoln Mali, joined Metro FM to share the story behind Lesaka. He spoke about what we’re building and what “Where you are, we are” really means. From bringing familiar brands together, to launching Lesaka in communities across Southern Africa - it’s about being where life and business are already happening, where people live, earn, spend and trade.


###


It’s also about understanding what people and businesses need and finding practical ways to help them pay, receive, borrow, insure and grow. Listen to the full conversation to get to know Lesaka, what we stand for and where we’re going next.


### ****


**Key Takeaways from the Interview**


- **The Lesaka Rebrand.** Mali explained how the company brought several well-known local businesses—including Kazang, EasyPay, and GAAP—together under the single name "Lesaka," which means "kraal" or "call" in Sepedi and Sesotho.
- **Community Presence.** Discussing the company's *"Where you are, we are"* brand promise, he noted that over 60% of Lesaka’s workforce operates directly inside local communities rather than waiting for customers to come to them.
- **Consumer Services.** Lesaka provides everyday financial tools for individuals, allowing them to pay bills, buy airtime and electricity, access affordable credit and insurance, and safely receive salaries or social grants.
- **Merchant Solutions.** For small and informal businesses, the platform offers card payment acceptance, smart cash vaults, digital supplier payments, and business funding.


****


You can watch the full segment on[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DiaEhJSbrcQ) , or explore more of Mali's background and leadership philosophy on[StartupList Africa](https://www.startuplist.africa/people/lincoln-mali) and his recent[YouTube interview on leadership](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5LFT42x0H3A) .
